cover_letter.greeting: Dear Lambda DC / Infrastructure Finance Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior FP&A Analyst, Data Center Finance role at Lambda. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What interests me is that this role follows a site from budget through deployment and operations, then checks the result against what was approved. Most finance roles only see one piece of that.

My closest experience is an MBA project: I built project- and portfolio-level models for a 6-project, 35.4 MW Illinois solar portfolio, evaluating capital structure, DSCR, NPV and levered IRR under post-ITC scenarios, with downside sensitivities. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses on capital allocation that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget changes. At Thomson Reuters I worked on cash flow analysis and reconciliation and supported monthly P&L forecasting and close for the ANZ region.

That maps to the driver-based site models, the variance work and the investment return analysis you describe. The solar project was coursework rather than a live build, and construction budgeting and lease accounting would be new to me, so I'd expect to learn a lot from the Data Center Development team. I'd bring careful modeling and clear explanations of what moved and why. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
